import inspect

from solution import sum_Of_Series


def test_issue_example_5():
    """Cube sum of first 5 natural numbers is 225."""
    assert sum_Of_Series(5) == 225  # 1+8+27+64+125 = 225


def test_issue_n_1():
    """Cube sum of first 1 natural number is 1."""
    assert sum_Of_Series(1) == 1  # 1**3 = 1


def test_issue_n_2():
    """Cube sum of first 2 natural numbers is 9."""
    assert sum_Of_Series(2) == 9  # 1+8 = 9


def test_issue_n_4():
    """Cube sum of first 4 natural numbers is 100."""
    assert sum_Of_Series(4) == 100  # 1+8+27+64 = 100


def test_issue_n_6():
    """Cube sum of first 6 natural numbers is 441."""
    assert sum_Of_Series(6) == 441  # 1+8+27+64+125+216 = 441


def test_issue_n_10():
    """Cube sum of first 10 natural numbers is 3025."""
    assert sum_Of_Series(10) == 3025  # (10*11/2)**2 = 55**2 = 3025


def test_issue_n_100():
    """Cube sum of first 100 natural numbers is 25502500."""
    assert sum_Of_Series(100) == 25502500  # (100*101/2)**2 = 5050**2 = 25502500


def test_issue_n_0_empty():
    """Cube sum of first 0 natural numbers is 0."""
    assert sum_Of_Series(0) == 0  # empty sum = 0


def test_contract_callable():
    """Public interface exposes callable sum_Of_Series."""
    assert callable(sum_Of_Series)


def test_contract_signature_has_n():
    """Public interface defines sum_Of_Series(n) with parameter n."""
    assert "n" in inspect.signature(sum_Of_Series).parameters


def test_contract_incremental_adds_next_cube():
    """Cube sum grows by n cubed when n increases by one."""
    assert sum_Of_Series(5) - sum_Of_Series(4) == 125  # 5**3 = 125


def test_contract_deterministic_repeat():
    """Same input n gives same cube sum on repeated calls."""
    first = sum_Of_Series(6)
    second = sum_Of_Series(6)
    assert first == second
